statement: theorem rational_decomposition {A : Type} (g : Abelian A) (ell m : Nat) (ell_form : ell = 4 * m + 1) (x : A) (annihilated : nsmul g (4 * ell) x = g.zero) : nsmul g 4 (nsmul g ell x) = g.zero ∧ nsmul g ell (g.add x (g.neg (nsmul g ell x))) = g.zero ∧ g.add (g.add x (g.neg (nsmul g ell x))) (nsmul g ell x) = x

theorem odd_half {J T : Type} (g : Abelian J) (h : Abelian T) (beta : Hom g h) (F : J → T) (twice_beta : ∀ x, F x = h.add (beta.toFun x) (beta.toFun x)) (ell inv : Nat) (inverse : 2 * inv = ell + 1) (x : J) (odd : nsmul g ell x = g.zero) : nsmul h inv (F x) = beta.toFun x
theorem evaluate_matches_beta {A J T : Type} (c : Config A J T) (x : J) : evaluate c x = c.beta.toFun x
theorem dlp_preservation {A J T : Type} (c : Config A J T) (G : J) (n : Nat) : evaluate c (nsmul c.g n G) = nsmul c.h n (evaluate c G)

theorem full_rational_inverse13 {J T : Type} (g : Abelian J) (h : Abelian T) (beta : Hom g h) (dual : Hom h g) (composition : ∀ x, dual.toFun (beta.toFun x) = nsmul g 13 x) (order : ∀ x, nsmul g 11092292 x = g.zero) (x : J) : nsmul g 3413013 (dual.toFun (beta.toFun x)) = x

theorem dlp_equivalence {A J T : Type} (c : Config A J T) (ell_identity : c.ell = 2773073) (dual : Hom c.h c.g) (composition : ∀ x, dual.toFun (c.beta.toFun x) = nsmul c.g 13 x) (Q G : J) (n : Nat) : (evaluate c Q = nsmul c.h n (evaluate c G)) ↔ Q = nsmul c.g n G
